items.title: Set a focused promise
items.goal: Specialist rivalry with an explanation worth keeping.
items.criteria: Choose three acquisition experiments and keep bot demand separate from human demand.
items.evidence: Market brief and executive decisions are recorded.
items.next: Review after the first observed cohort.

items.title: Audit the market
items.goal: Compare current products and size assumptions.
items.criteria: Five public competitors, primary sources, dated evidence, explicit model formulas and limitations.
items.evidence: 16 market sources; hypothetical TAM, SAM and obtainable cohort.
items.next: Replace assumed interest rates with observed willingness to play.

items.title: Translate learning research
items.goal: Use choice, feedback and retrieval without coercive hooks.
items.criteria: Document scope of papers and book excerpts; separate hypotheses from effects established for this game.
items.evidence: 13 research and author/publisher sources; screen and sound contracts.
items.next: Observe whether explanations earn voluntary review.

items.title: Build an original visual identity
items.goal: Make sport and science feel like one knowledge club.
items.criteria: Responsive navy/cobalt and light themes, original generic covers, clear labelled states.
items.evidence: Current FACT//DUEL midnight/chartreuse identity and original metallic artwork supersede the historical v3/v4 palettes; alternate light theme retained.
items.next: Observe whether players understand the new lobby before adding more decoration.

items.title: Make first play direct
items.goal: Place match setup before editorial discovery on mobile.
items.criteria: Bot, friend and join routes; free entry default; remembered name; one primary start action.
items.evidence: Play builder, topic selection and clear empty-pool recovery implemented.
items.next: Measure unassisted first-use completion in P17.

items.title: Offer three coherent duels
items.goal: One, up to three, or all five rounds using the same fair rules.
items.criteria: Quick Draw, Triple Threat and Gauntlet work with both opponent types; no repeated question in one deck.
items.evidence: Server mode validation, deck selection and settlement updated.
items.next: Extend only when a new mode adds a distinct player objective.

items.title: Keep bot practice honest
items.goal: Make immediate play available without pretending a bot is a person.
items.criteria: Uniform choices; independent random delay; precommitted plans; no adaptation; disclosed simulated receipt.
items.evidence: Bot is clearly labelled and automatically ready; plans remain server-side.
items.next: Check all three modes and timers in P12.

items.title: Turn results into a journal
items.goal: Keep an explanation after the race ends.
items.criteria: Record only revealed results, deduplicate round IDs, cap storage, distinguish bot matches and saved facts.
items.evidence: Versioned IndexedDB journal/profile, stable settled fact IDs, bookmarks, queued export, confirmed unified reset and frozen Recall Lab deck.
items.next: Observe browser failure/recovery and source comprehension.

items.title: Make choices and feedback legible
items.goal: Keep selected input visible while pending.
items.criteria: Pressed semantics; keyboard answer route; mute visible during play; reduced-motion CSS; controls sized for touch.
items.evidence: Source changes address first advisor review. Device testing is a separate gate.
items.next: Complete P15 and P16 before wider recruitment.

items.title: Add optional audio
items.goal: Use restrained original synthesized cues.
items.criteria: Off by default; remembered volume; no panic ticking; no replay on preference changes; visual equivalents.
items.evidence: Countdown, answer-lock and outcome cues; one-event guards.
items.next: Phone-speaker and screen-reader coexistence check in P16.

items.title: Complete first critique loop
items.goal: Catch navigation and integrity flaws before release.
items.criteria: Record prioritized issues and acceptance criteria, then map each issue to an implementation or explicit deferral.
items.evidence: First source review records 10 findings; fixes implemented in P05–P10.
items.next: Second review checks actual code in P13.

items.title: Verify the release gates
items.goal: Protect timing, immutable attempts, settlement and journal data.
items.criteria: All automated gameplay, transport, bot and journal tests pass; TypeScript and production build pass.
items.evidence: Historical v3 gate: 39 automated tests, TypeScript and production build passed. Current arcade gates are R15.
items.next: Preserve as historical evidence; consult current release record.

items.title: Complete second critique loop
items.goal: Check implemented code independently.
items.criteria: Revisit first-loop issues, report remaining blockers, and fix or explicitly defer with reasons.
items.evidence: Historical v3 two-loop review completed. Curiosity Arcade adds the two new loops in R05/R13.
items.next: Consult the new advisor record and observed pilot gates.

items.title: Prepare permitted testers
items.goal: Make two-screen friend sessions possible within private access.
items.criteria: Document permitted testers, invite access and test devices; verify both can open the private site.
items.evidence: Room invites do not grant Site access.
items.next: Arrange a small approved tester group; no public acquisition yet.

items.title: Verify real mobile flows
items.goal: Observe actual small screens, large text and touch.
items.criteria: 320–430px phones; portrait/landscape; 200% zoom; long answers; keyboard/safe areas; no inaccessible primary actions.
items.evidence: Responsive source rules are implemented; no device session is claimed.
items.next: Record device/OS/browser and defects for each play state.

items.title: Run assistive and audio checks
items.goal: Make the available controls operable and understandable.
items.criteria: Keyboard-only flow, visible focus, dialog focus return, screen-reader names/status, muted and audible outcomes, reduced motion.
items.evidence: Source semantics and core contrast pairs checked; full conformance not established.
items.next: Include disabled and focus variants; repair before cohort expansion.

items.title: Observe ten first sessions
items.goal: Test comprehension before growth.
items.criteria: At least 8/10 complete unassisted and explain one attempt, random bot and tie rule; log every intervention.
items.evidence: Management threshold, not an industry benchmark.
items.next: Simplify setup if recurring confusion survives one repair loop.

items.title: Exercise two distant screens
items.goal: Measure whether casual timing outcomes stay understandable.
items.criteria: Wi-Fi/mobile mix, asymmetric delay, jitter, loss, throttled CPU, tab hiding and reconnect; record raw and reported durations.
items.evidence: Local tests are not WAN or physical display measurements.
items.next: Publish distributions and refunds; adjust explicit uncertainty policy from evidence.

items.title: Specify a consented event model
items.goal: Separate people, matches, rounds and bots.
items.criteria: Define eligible starter, activation, days 7–13 return, invite acceptance and human-match completion; document consent and retention.
items.evidence: No remote product analytics or cohort dashboard is implemented.
items.next: Review exact event fields and deletion behavior before collection.

items.title: Instrument the approved pilot
items.goal: Collect minimal evidence for product decisions.
items.criteria: Deploy consented events, sampling and deletion; no answer keys or invite tokens in analytics; verify event idempotency.
items.evidence: Blocked on event/consent decisions and observed flow repair.
items.next: Choose a minimal sink and prove counts reconcile to a test cohort.

items.title: Run one repair cycle
items.goal: Fix observed friction before adding features.
items.criteria: Rank defects by failed completion and trust; replay affected flows with different testers.
items.evidence: No user-research outcome is claimed yet.
items.next: Record issue, change and observed outcome together.

items.title: Choose narrow launch decks
items.goal: Promote coverage the bank can sustain.
items.criteria: India cricket, European football and space/science have clear era/entity bounds and assigned maintainers.
items.evidence: Current sample: 54 questions, six per topic across nine topics.
items.next: Use actual collection counts; do not advertise exhaustive club histories.

items.title: Research 120 distinct fact families
items.goal: Give each of three promoted decks at least 40 reviewed families.
items.criteria: Primary source, archived access date, exact scope, four defensible options, original explanation and family ID per item.
items.evidence: research-duel-questions skill is available; the additional questions are not yet authored.
items.next: Start with frozen history and stable science; prioritize ambiguity review.

items.title: Audit every candidate
items.goal: Prevent repeated facts and ambiguous answer keys.
items.criteria: Independent answer verification; plausible distractors; unit/era/sex/competition clarity; conflict resolution and source rights recorded.
items.evidence: Automated drafting alone cannot approve a question.
items.next: Reject unsourced superlatives, unstable records without as-of dates and copied prose.

items.title: Calibrate reading and difficulty
items.goal: Fit questions to mode and timer.
items.criteria: Measure length, timeouts, accuracy and ambiguity flags by audience; enough respondents before difficulty labels become empirical.
items.evidence: Current simple/expert/extreme labels are editorial.
items.next: Keep identical competitive cards; no hidden adaptive advantages.

items.title: Create correction and retirement tools
items.goal: Maintain trust after publication.
items.criteria: Report-question flow, quarantine switch, versioned corrections, review dates and audit trail; affected facts can be retired.
items.evidence: Current source links are visible; in-app disputes and remote retirement are planned.
items.next: Add the smallest moderation surface before opening submissions.

items.title: Test language readiness
items.goal: Validate actual English comprehension by launch cohort.
items.criteria: Cognitive interviews on cards; first localized deck only after equivalent meaning and distractor quality are reviewed.
items.evidence: English readiness in SAM is assumed; no Hindi or other localized bank is shipped.
items.next: Recalculate reachable audience when reading readiness is observed.

items.title: Expand to 300, then 600 families
items.goal: Scale depth only after upkeep works.
items.criteria: Each expansion gate has sufficient unseen coverage, named maintainers and no unresolved critical factual errors.
items.evidence: Blocked on quality, throughput and real session repetition.
items.next: Basketball/NFL, tennis, biology, physics and computing follow measured preference.

items.title: Recruit three separate cohorts
items.goal: Test audience preference with bounded effort.
items.criteria: At least 100 activated participants per wedge across multiple communities; label recruiting bias and separate bots/humans.
items.evidence: No community messages, ad campaigns or paid acquisition have been sent.
items.next: Use permitted communities and consented invitations once pilot gates pass.

items.title: Review activation and return
items.goal: Measure chosen repeat value, not session inflation.
items.criteria: Target ≥70% first-match completion and ≥25% return in days 7–13; denominators and uncertainty shown.
items.evidence: These are proposed management gates; no retention is measured yet.
items.next: Below 15% return after two repair cycles: pause expansion.

items.title: Test human social value
items.goal: Check whether friend play merits investment.
items.criteria: Target ≥15% voluntary inviters and ≥50% accepted invites completing a match; track access failures separately.
items.evidence: A bot rematch is not a human social conversion.
items.next: Repair failed room entry before recruiting more users.

items.title: Re-estimate SAM from observations
items.goal: Replace assumptions before expanding scope.
items.criteria: Report audience definition, sampled interest, overlap, English readiness, uncertainty and reachable channel constraints.
items.evidence: 57.6m base SAM remains an illustrative future scenario.
items.next: Choose one primary wedge; do not rank tiny differences as proof.

items.title: Test a voluntary weekly ritual
items.goal: Encourage return without a punishment loop.
items.criteria: One opt-in weekly goal with a stopping point; no streak loss, fake scarcity, paid advantage or notification default-on.
items.evidence: Weekly collections and friend rituals are proposals, not shipped features.
items.next: Compare qualitative value and consented return; retire if it adds pressure without value.

items.title: Measure present operating cost
items.goal: Use real metrics before changing transport.
items.criteria: Track concurrent active rooms, polls/sec, p50/p95/p99 request time, D1 contention, refunds and error rates under a documented load mix.
items.evidence: Active 500ms polling means roughly four state requests/sec per two-human room; bot rooms roughly two.
items.next: Repeat production-like load with actual service limits; local stress is not a capacity promise.

items.title: Bound room and abuse costs
items.goal: Protect availability during wider access.
items.criteria: Per-identity creation/read limits, maximum active rooms, TTL cleanup, audit bounds and observability without secret logging.
items.evidence: Existing room expiry and request checks do not equal a complete abuse program.
items.next: Set budgets from traffic measurements and enforce at a shared boundary.

items.title: Evaluate per-room actors and push
items.goal: Reduce polling where it is actually expensive.
items.criteria: Prototype one authoritative room actor, WebSocket reconnect snapshot/revision protocol and durable deadlines; compare cost/tail latency.
items.evidence: No WebSocket or actor migration is shipped.
items.next: Keep state transitions idempotent; do not infer physical zero latency from push.

items.title: Design ranked fairness separately
items.goal: Keep browser timing limitations explicit.
items.criteria: Threat model replay/tampering/automation, timing uncertainty, device bias and disconnect abuse; choose score-first or unranked outcomes where needed.
items.evidence: Local timing can reduce packet bias but cannot prove an honest client.
items.next: No paid stakes or verified ranking until the trust model is deliberately resolved.

items.title: Add accounts only for demonstrated need
items.goal: Enable cross-device collections without inventing a wallet.
items.criteria: Auth, account deletion, journal migration/merge, retention and session revocation; separate any future ledger from room JSON.
items.evidence: Current journal and roadmap are browser-local; room coins reset each match.
items.next: Validate demand for cross-device continuity before scope expansion.

items.title: Test recovery and rollout
items.goal: Fail safely under process, region and database faults.
items.criteria: Soak/load/fault tests, duplicate settlement checks, reconnect resync, rollback rehearsal and documented observed limits.
items.evidence: Single local load result does not certify a production ceiling.
items.next: Define SLOs from pilot behavior and stop rollouts on violated invariants.

items.title: Approve the next investment
items.goal: Make expansion a decision with evidence.
items.criteria: Review retention, trust, editorial cost, accessibility and operating budgets; explicit go/repair/stop with owners.
items.evidence: Private free-coin POC remains the current release boundary.
items.next: Legal and access review precede any change to the existing launch constraints.

items.title: Inspect trivia customer criticism
items.goal: Translate actual review incidents into specific safeguards.
items.criteria: Dated deduplicated observations, locator, unknown-version fields and official counterchecks.
items.evidence: 16 observations across four trivia apps; 17 source records.
items.next: Refresh disputed or old cases before a market comparison.

items.title: Inspect adjacent learning products
items.goal: Preserve useful motivation while reducing avoidable pressure and confusion.
items.criteria: Include criticism and positive counterexamples; qualify entitlement and accessibility claims.
items.evidence: 16 observations across four learning products; 18 source records.
items.next: Recruit actual players; do not infer prevalence from this sample.

items.title: Choose evidence-informed play and art contracts
items.goal: Make every additional reward serve an understandable activity.
items.criteria: Primary-study limits, bounded book access and specific screen/state definitions.
items.evidence: Eight-source brief; Curiosity Arcade direction; source-backed finite activity loops.
items.next: Test meaning, comprehension and freedom to stop.

items.title: Create and exercise a reusable design skill
items.goal: Make the review-to-implementation process reproducible.
items.criteria: Validate/install skill, apply it to raw evidence, retain unverified gates.
items.evidence: Review-led Game Design skill installed and forward-tested; six prioritized requirements.
items.next: Reuse for next review refresh; no background automation is active.

items.title: Run pre-implementation advisor loop
items.goal: Catch state, timing and evidence hazards before adding progression.
items.criteria: Independent source review with consequence and acceptance criteria.
items.evidence: Loop 1 recorded 11 hazards; decisions and fixes tracked.
items.next: Reinspect implementation in R13.

items.title: Bind activity to stable fact identities
items.goal: Avoid duplicate credit from rewording and repeat rooms.
items.criteria: IDs released only after duel closure; awards survive rolling journal caps.
items.evidence: Settled projection IDs and separate 1,200-ID ledger; repeat/edited/cap tests.
items.next: Add content versions and migration/retirement policy before bank expansion.

items.title: Make local saves, exports and reset coherent
items.goal: Preserve browser-local activity through concurrent tabs and retries.
items.criteria: Transactional writes, queued exports, generation reset, visible failure semantics.
items.evidence: IndexedDB + BroadcastChannel; 30 concurrent writes exercised with fake IndexedDB; advisor fixes inspected.
items.next: Observe actual browser quota, blocked storage and recovery.

items.title: Open untimed Discovery before the first match
items.goal: Let first visitors complete a pressure-free loop.
items.criteria: Three unique sourced cards, one attempt each, explanation/save/next/finish; no room/coin mutation.
items.evidence: Practice API and complete Discovery UI; duplicate-attempt and API regressions.
items.next: Observe first-use comprehension; teaching answers intentionally available.

items.title: Implement Passport and guaranteed finishes
items.goal: Connect exploration, explanation and practice without decay or paid advantage.
items.criteria: Three finite missions, explicit 10/5/5 activity rules, deterministic cosmetics and real counts.
items.evidence: Passport/titles/Orbit/Grid/Rally; eligibility/idempotence/corrupt-state regressions.
items.next: Measure whether players understand activity versus knowledge.

items.title: Build original optional 3D artwork
items.goal: Give the lobby a memorable, tactile identity.
items.criteria: Static fallback, explicit opt-in, capped rendering, disposal and no renderer in a room.
items.evidence: Historical Curiosity Arcade stage shipped. Current optional 3D lives in a separate showroom and uses a metallic token/orbit scene; all prior fallback/lifecycle guards remain.
items.next: Measure actual low-end-device performance in R16.

items.title: Rebuild responsive play hierarchy
items.goal: Keep mobile first play direct and answers stable.
items.criteria: Game builder before art; named navigation; CTA before advanced settings; 44px key controls.
items.evidence: Historical Curiosity Arcade layout shipped. S01 supersedes its palette and home hierarchy; click-release input remains the contract.
items.next: Observe phone, zoom, screen-reader and pointer transitions; source is not physical QA.

items.title: Make the Vault a stable revisit space
items.goal: Preserve context when other tabs save new facts.
items.criteria: Stable recall snapshot, source/bookmark routes, clear empty/finish state.
items.evidence: Frozen recall deck; epoch reset closes stale study; unified export and source disclosures.
items.next: Observe a user finding, reading, recalling and finishing.

items.title: Close the second advisor loop
items.goal: Repair concrete defects in the implemented paths.
items.criteria: Review findings resolved or explicitly gated with evidence.
items.evidence: All B01–B07 resolved in source; 15 targeted tests independently passed; no reviewed source blocker.
items.next: Keep empirical gates open; inspect Studio evidence separately.

items.title: Publish inspectable review evidence and plan
items.goal: Make the research and implementation reviewable.
items.criteria: Searchable 32-row evidence panel, full briefs, source/issue counts and honest release decisions.
items.evidence: 32 observations/8 apps, 69 source URLs and historical Curiosity Arcade report remain accessible. Current decision record and roadmap incorporate the rivalry pass.
items.next: Use local notes/export to record actual observations; refresh source versions.

items.title: Verify and build the private arcade release
items.goal: Confirm existing duel invariants and new local progression contracts.
items.criteria: 52 regressions pass, TypeScript passes, production build succeeds; preserve owner-private access.
items.evidence: Historical v4 verification: 52 regressions, TypeScript and production build passed. Current pass is S05.
items.next: Run observed gates before broadening audience.

items.title: Observe graphics and touch on real devices
items.goal: Validate the new design where source checks cannot.
items.criteria: 320–430px, landscape, 200% zoom, low-end/no-WebGL, reduced-motion, context-loss, keyboard and screen reader; capture failures.
items.evidence: No physical-device or GPU session performed.
items.next: Recruit permitted testers and exercise static/3D, scroll/click, export/reset and recall across tabs.

items.title: Broaden review sampling by audience
items.goal: Reduce the English/public-listing blind spots.
items.criteria: Predeclare region/language/platform quotas; sample recent versions and positive/mixed/critical cases with repeatable locators.
items.evidence: Current purposive sample is not globally representative.
items.next: Add India/local-language and European storefront research when those launches are concrete.

items.title: Create a question-report and correction loop
items.goal: Respond to disputed facts without silently rewriting past results.
items.criteria: Versioned report receipt, editorial review, correction/retirement and affected-match trace; disclose local-only reports if used.
items.evidence: Local concern records, encountered-fact snapshots, note editing, export and reset are implemented in S03. Remote delivery, editorial status and versioned correction remain unimplemented.
items.next: Define the editorial workflow using inspectable exported local records; implement remote reporting only with that service.

items.title: Validate activity meaning and voluntary return
items.goal: Check whether the gamification serves the intended curiosity experience.
items.criteria: Observe ten first sessions; users can explain stamps, locate source and stop; later return tracked only with approved consent.
items.evidence: No measured learning gain, retention lift or customer satisfaction effect.
items.next: Run task-based sessions before changing reward schedules.

items.title: Control repeat exposure before competitive expansion
items.goal: Avoid treating memorized sample buttons as new knowledge.
items.criteria: Versioned fact families, per-player exposure policy, insufficient-pool fallback and minimum deck-depth gate.
items.evidence: Within-match unique sampling and stable activity IDs exist; across-room repeat suppression does not.
items.next: Research 120 audited families, then implement exposure-aware matching.

items.title: Rebuild the competitive identity and first-play hierarchy
items.goal: Make a real duel the dominant first action.
items.criteria: Direct default bot play, distinct format contracts, mobile builder before artwork, consistent dark/light identity.
items.evidence: FACT//DUEL midnight/chartreuse design, original metallic artwork, focused lobby and compact HUD.
items.next: Observe first-play and narrow-screen flows.

items.title: Retain and explain the whole match
items.goal: Keep all completed rounds inspectable without leaking future answers.
items.criteria: Five-round snapshots deduplicate; only closed answer/receipt fields exposed; whole-match verdict separate from final round.
items.evidence: New retained history and recap tabs, exact choices, timing types, cancellation recovery and secrecy regressions.
items.next: Observe two-screen recovery and final-result comprehension.

items.title: Save and edit local question concerns
items.goal: Preserve the fact and concern together without implying a support service.
items.criteria: Encountered snapshot, reason/note, idempotent save/update, local status, Vault/export/reset and old-profile migration.
items.evidence: Local issue form and Vault list implemented; note updates/migration/reset tested. Nothing is sent.
items.next: Use the receipts to specify remote editorial reporting in R18.

items.title: Resolve the rivalry advisor findings
items.goal: Repair semantic and state defects in the revised flow.
items.criteria: Direct replay, accurate timeout denominator, actual choices, bot labels, cancelled history, void labels and light contrast.
items.evidence: Two bounded advisor passes; nine findings repaired or source-mitigated; no reviewed code blocker.
items.next: Keep physical rendering and interaction observations pending.

items.title: Verify and publish the rivalry pass
items.goal: Keep prior duel invariants intact while completing the improved experience.
items.criteria: 58 regressions, TypeScript and production build pass; private audience preserved; documents reconcile.
items.evidence: New automated cases cover five-round history, issues, recap recovery and presentation correctness.
items.next: Run P15/P16/P18 and R16 before claiming device or WAN validation.

items.title: Build a finite, game-native front door
items.goal: Choose a meaningful visit objective and keep competitive play direct.
items.criteria: Clubhouse, nine narrow six-question routes, three named chapters, Continue, direct bot modes, separate friend/join/settings and visible stamp case.
items.evidence: New Clubhouse, expedition atlas, chapter screens and collectible case implemented; existing 3D/art reused.
items.next: Observe first-session navigation and route comprehension.

items.title: Make confidence a real scoring decision
items.goal: Add agency before every first answer without coin advantages.
items.criteria: Steady +2/0 and Bold +3/−1; signed totals; immutable first choices; stamp at any score; exact score feasibility validation.
items.evidence: New pure rule reducer, locked stance/answer, run score and source-backed receipts; all-correct/all-wrong and corrupted-score tests.
items.next: Ask players to explain the two choices and observe whether they use them deliberately.

items.title: Make progress durable, bounded and honest
items.goal: Pause and resume each route without overwriting or farming rewards.
items.criteria: Atomic journal/run transition, exact run/index guards, reset epoch, six-answered-awaiting-Finish recovery, first/best separation, nine bounded snapshots, export/migration.
items.evidence: Reducer and transaction races pass; duplicate Finish cannot earn twice; malformed completed-run ownership is sanitized.
items.next: Test real browser storage failure, two tabs and refresh flows; define future version archive before route-key changes.

items.title: Challenge the new loop with independent evidence
items.goal: Separate substantive mechanics from decorative progression.
items.criteria: Two source-review passes, primary/official research access ledger, exact limitations, four findings repaired.
items.evidence: Seven-source bounded report; independent advisor accepted the core as substantive and identified feedback/navigation/corruption repairs.
items.next: Use empirical gates instead of assuming retention or mastery effects.

items.title: Verify and publish the expedition release
items.goal: Preserve existing live-duel invariants while releasing the new solo mode.
items.criteria: 68 tests, TypeScript and production build pass; private access retained; current reports and links reconcile.
items.evidence: New expedition, score-corruption and concurrent browser-transaction regressions; source-only review boundary documented.
items.next: Run explicit browser/device/WAN checks in existing gates before claiming observed validation.

items.title: Observe the complete expedition-to-duel flow
items.goal: Determine whether people understand the objective, score and reward.
items.criteria: Observe start, confidence choice, pause/resume, finish, source review, stamp inspection and voluntary duel start; report denominator and confusion.
items.evidence: No customer or browser observation this turn.
items.next: Recruit an authorized formative cohort and define tasks before collecting data.

items.title: Deepen the editorial packs beyond six questions
items.goal: Give returning fans a reason to play beyond memorized sample cards.
items.criteria: Use research-duel-questions skill; draft versioned question families, primary sources, ambiguity checks, balanced distractors, rights and calibration plan.
items.evidence: 54 existing items mapped into narrow routes; no new question research claimed.
items.next: Prioritize one sports and one science route using observed demand; preserve old run receipts before shipping replacements.

items.title: Specify compatible route-version history
items.goal: Expand content without erasing or mislabeling earlier achievements.
items.criteria: Archive old first/best summaries and frozen receipts; distinguish changed facts from new item families; define migration and reset/export compatibility.
items.evidence: Current route keys contain version 1; snapshots are frozen, but future retired-version archive is not implemented.
items.next: Design and test a v1-to-v2 migration before changing or removing a route key.

items.title: Research gamification theory and the 2026 web 3D stack
items.goal: Ground every design decision in primary sources.
items.criteria: Octalysis, Hooked, Reality is Broken, Art of Game Design, Game Feel, Juice it or lose it, SDT/PENS, Duolingo notes, Kahoot/QuizUp/Trivia Royale mechanics; measured bundle sizes for R3F, drei, rapier, motion.
items.evidence: public/product/gamification/research-brief.md with URLs and locally measured gzip sizes.
items.next: Refresh when React 19.3 or fiber 10 ships (peer range).

items.title: Audit the current UI and engine
items.goal: Know every screen, token, reducer, test and constraint before touching anything.
items.criteria: Screen inventory, design-system debt, profile schema, reducer identity contract, timing contract, tests that pin behaviour.
items.evidence: Two audit reports; baseline screenshots at 390 and 1440 px (desktop nav was rendering as a stacked column).
items.next: Re-audit after the screen rebuild.

items.title: Write the Floodlight design bible
items.goal: One system, two temperatures: warm competition, cool learning; volt brand energy.
items.criteria: Palette (oklch), type (Bricolage Grotesque / Instrument Sans / JetBrains Mono), shape-coded answers, motion vocabulary, sound map, 3D rules, honesty guardrails, screen briefs.
items.evidence: public/product/gamification/design-bible.md.
items.next: Revise after advisor loop 1.

items.title: Create swarm skills
items.goal: Every agent builds from the same card.
items.criteria: floodlight-design, juice, gamification-advisor skills under .claude/skills.
items.evidence: Skills committed.
items.next: Extend with component recipes as they land.

items.title: Ship tokens and fonts
items.goal: Replace three generations of CSS variables with one token set.
items.criteria: app/theme/tokens.css with legacy aliases; Google Fonts with system fallbacks; Tailwind bridge updated; dead plum/coral root removed.
items.evidence: Pending foundation report.
items.next: Delete legacy aliases once every screen uses fd- classes.

items.title: Build the responsive app shell
items.goal: Bottom tab bar on phones, icon rail on desktop, hidden during a live room.
items.criteria: Top bar with streak/gems/level slots, 5 tabs with data-nav hooks, settings sheet with sound, volume, haptics, effects, theme; 100dvh; safe areas; zero overflow at 390 px.
items.evidence: Pending.
items.next: Add view transitions when Firefox support settles.

items.title: Decompose the arena monolith
items.goal: Let screen teams work in parallel without breaking the timing contract.
items.criteria: app/arena.tsx keeps state, networking, reveal marker and keyboard; app/screens/* are presentational with a typed DuelController; 68 tests, tsc and build stay green; end-to-end bot duel screenshots.
items.evidence: Pending.
items.next: Consider a router with history once screens are stable.

items.title: Progression engine: XP and levels
items.goal: Exactly-once XP from before/after profile diffs.
items.criteria: lib/progression.mjs pure; profile stays version 2 with default-fill; xpToNext(l)=round(80·l^1.55); titles per band; identity-preserving no-ops; tests.
items.evidence: Pending engine report.
items.next: Tune the curve after observed play.

items.title: Streaks with shields
items.goal: Daily return loop without punishment.
items.criteria: Local day keys; shield every 7 days (max 2) auto-protects gaps; visit action on load; streak XP bonus.
items.evidence: Pending.
items.next: Offer a shield purchase in the Locker if players ask.

items.title: Daily quests
items.goal: Three seeded quests per day that spread play across modes and topics.
items.criteria: Deterministic seed from epoch+date; easy/medium/hard templates; auto-claim; all-three bonus.
items.evidence: Pending.
items.next: Weekly quests after the daily loop is observed.

items.title: Achievements
items.goal: About 30 badges in bronze/silver/gold with two hidden.
items.criteria: Unlock exactly once; XP and gems on unlock; sanitised ids.
items.evidence: Pending.
items.next: Add route-specific badges when the bank grows.

items.title: Arena Rank (device-local)
items.goal: A ladder without a server: rank points from duel results with tier floors.
items.criteria: Bronze to Diamond thresholds; demotion protection; rank-up log entries.
items.evidence: Pending.
items.next: Replace with server-backed leagues when identity exists (G32).

items.title: Gems and the Locker
items.goal: Ownership: earn gems, spend on frames, titles, banners, accents; nothing auto-spent.
items.criteria: Wallet, cosmetics catalogue, buy/equip guards, unlock by level, achievement or rank.
items.evidence: Pending.
items.next: Passport card finishes could join the Locker later.

items.title: Difficulty plumbing
items.goal: Difficulty-weighted XP needs difficulty in journaled rounds.
items.criteria: difficulty added to retained round snapshots and practice/expedition cards; optional in validFact; tests unchanged.
items.evidence: Pending.
items.next: Persist region/domain too if per-region mastery is wanted.

items.title: Procedural sound engine
items.goal: Every action answers back in sound with zero audio assets.
items.criteria: Web Audio synth with 20+ cues, gesture unlock, prefs, throttling, loudness normalised.
items.evidence: Pending juice report.
items.next: Tune cue mix after listening sessions.

items.title: Particles, confetti, shake, counters
items.goal: Juice it or lose it, on the web.
items.criteria: Pooled Canvas2D engine with physics; bursts, confetti, float text, ring pulse; NumberCounter; shake; reduced-motion paths.
items.evidence: Pending.
items.next: GPU particle path if profiling shows need.

items.title: Haptics and effect preferences
items.goal: Mirror sound on Android; user control over motion.
items.criteria: navigator.vibrate patterns; fact-duel-haptics and fact-duel-motion keys; settings wiring.
items.evidence: Pending.
items.next: iOS switch-haptic hack only if Safari keeps it.

items.title: Toasts and ceremonies
items.goal: Level-ups, badges, stamps and streak milestones deserve a stage.
items.criteria: Stacked aria-live toasts; focus-trapped ceremony overlay with a 3D slot and Continue button; queueing.
items.evidence: Pending.
items.next: Share-card export from a ceremony later.

items.title: 3D Knowledge Core hero
items.goal: A living arena object on Home that grows with level.
items.criteria: R3F client-only; wire icosahedron, glowing core, orbit rings, sprites; dpr ≤1.5; pauses offscreen; reduced-motion static frame; no network assets.
items.evidence: Pending 3D report.
items.next: Add level-based colour shifts and seasonal variants.

items.title: 3D Reward Medal
items.goal: Ceremonies get a physical object.
items.criteria: Gold/silver/bronze/enamel variants, spring flip-in, sparkles, geometry-only emblem.
items.evidence: Pending.
items.next: Route-specific stamp emblems.

items.title: Gem Vault physics showpiece
items.goal: Real physics where it delights: gems dropping into a tray in the Locker.
items.criteria: Rapier loaded only on demand (about 820 kB gz), instanced bodies, sleep, nudge on tap, CSS fallback.
items.evidence: Pending.
items.next: Consider matter-js 2D if rapier weight hurts low-end phones.

items.title: Rebuild Home (Arena Hub)
items.goal: One glance: who you are, what to do next, what you will earn.
items.criteria: Hero with 3D core + player card (level ring, XP, streak, gems); Play now; 3 daily quests; Continue expedition; featured route; rank strip; XP log.
items.evidence: Not started.
items.next: A/B copy on the primary CTA after observation.

items.title: Rebuild Play (duel builder)
items.goal: Two taps from lobby to question.
items.criteria: Mode cards with reward preview, opponent picker, topic chips, sticky launch CTA on phones, honest bot labelling.
items.evidence: Not started.
items.next: Power-ups only after the core loop is observed.

items.title: Rebuild the Room (lobby, countdown, question, reveal, finish)
items.goal: Broadcast-grade feel without touching the timing contract.
items.criteria: Kinetic countdown with Wild Round call-out; shape-coded answers; speed bar; combo meter; result juice after round.result only; verdict with true margin, XP and rank deltas counting up; rematch.
items.evidence: Not started.
items.next: Spectator/replay view later.

items.title: Rebuild Expeditions
items.goal: Field-notes texture, chapter camps, endowed progress, stamp ceremony.
items.criteria: Route cards, satisfying steady/bold switch, camp progress, goal-gradient intensity near the end, finish ceremony with 3D stamp.
items.evidence: Not started.
items.next: Community mapping meter when a server exists.

items.title: Rebuild Player (Passport, Rank, Locker)
items.goal: Ownership and accomplishment on one screen.
items.criteria: Level card, Arena Rank, 14-day streak calendar, per-topic mastery bars, achievements gallery with silhouettes, stamp case, Locker with gems.
items.evidence: Not started.
items.next: Shareable player card image.

items.title: Rebuild Vault, Discovery and Collections
items.goal: Learning surfaces in the cool palette with juice.
items.criteria: Fact cards tinted by difficulty, recall lab feedback, saved/flagged views, topic tickets with mastery.
items.evidence: Not started.
items.next: Spaced-repetition scheduling later.

items.title: Wire progression feedback everywhere
items.goal: Every XP, quest, badge, level, rank and streak change is felt once.
items.criteria: usePlayer exposes progression; a hook diffs before/after and dispatches toasts/ceremonies exactly once; question surface stays quiet.
items.evidence: Not started.
items.next: Batch toasts during rapid sequences.

items.title: Advisor loop 1
items.goal: Independent review against the bible and theory.
items.criteria: Scores per screen, prioritised P0/P1/P2 list, fixes dispatched and verified.
items.evidence: Not started.
items.next: Loop 2 after fixes.

items.title: Verification and advisor loop 2
items.goal: Release gate for the gamified build.
items.criteria: Tests, tsc, build, screenshot sweep at 390/1440 with and without reduced motion, end-to-end bot duel, bundle sizes; verification.md; advisor sign-off.
items.evidence: Not started.
items.next: Physical-device QA remains an observed gate.

items.title: Docs and Studio update
items.goal: Keep README, product docs and the Studio roadmap truthful.
items.criteria: README sections for progression, juice, 3D and settings; decision record; roadmap.json synced in lib and public; Studio renders the gamification record.
items.evidence: Not started.
items.next: Archive superseded v6 guardrails with rationale.

items.title: Server-backed leagues and leaderboards
items.goal: Real relatedness needs identity and a settlement-time write.
items.criteria: New D1 table; attribution via authenticated user id at settlement; read action; small friend leagues; never derived from client XP.
items.evidence: Blocked by account identity; device-local rank ships first.
items.next: Design after the private pilot observes demand.

items.title: Bot personas with accuracy tiers
items.goal: A ladder of labelled practice bots.
items.criteria: Planner accepts an accuracy parameter; plans stay fixed and hidden; timing tests extended; UI labels every persona as BOT.
items.evidence: Not started; Lucky Guess remains the only bot.
items.next: Ship after the rank loop is observed.

items.title: Curated events calendar
items.goal: Tie the app to what is actually happening in sport and science.
items.criteria: Every date and result found and independently re-checked against a primary or reference source; static data with the verification date shown to players; no live feed implied.
items.evidence: 62 events across nine topics; 64 of 64 survived independent verification; two dropped for having no matching question topic.
items.next: Refresh monthly using the checklist and the health-check script.

items.title: Monthly limited-time modes
items.goal: A reason to come back that changes with the world, not with a timer.
items.criteria: Deterministic per month and dataset; eight templates across live, upcoming and past; sets an exact duel; pays a flat bonus and mints a badge once.
items.evidence: 23 engine tests; verified across five timezones; badge paid once across replays.
items.next: Watch whether players actually play the mode rather than the topic.

items.title: Seed investor evidence base and deck
items.goal: Argue the opportunity with numbers that survive checking.
items.criteria: Bottom-up TAM/SAM/SOM; competitor figures from filings and store listings; projections labelled as plans; every number sourced; unverifiable claims quarantined.
items.evidence: 119 of 127 claims verified independently; 26-slide deck; an adversarial pass raised 119 problems across 14 slides, all corrected or deleted.
items.next: Replace benchmark inputs with observed cohort data once the product has users.
